itemized.notes: HUMAN LOOK RECOMMENDED: both sides carry a 1.00 delta between the filer's own printed TOTAL (317.00) and his own two rows (266.00 + 52.00 = 318.00). Escalated to 1200 dpi on every amount; nothing is illegible and no single-digit re-read closes it (266 → 265 or 52 → 51 would each close it, but neither is what the page shows). Recorded as the filer's arithmetic per the cardinal rule. TABLE A ROW SLOT 0 IS FULLY STRUCK OUT — a dense scribble in the Date column obliterating whatever was written; nothing survives the strikeout at 1200 dpi, so no row is emitted for it and the fact is recorded here. DATES CARRY NO YEAR: the filer wrote 'Jan 8' and 'Mar 30', so every date field is BLANK with the verbatim in the row note — the year is never filled from the report period. Both Table A rows put text in the In-Kind / Tangible items column ('Filing Fee', 'Printing') that duplicates the Table B purposes exactly, i.e. the candidate paying campaign costs personally; in_kind is set from the column as printed and the cell is quoted verbatim, but this may be a DESCRIPTION rather than an in-kind good — not resolved. Page 3 carries only the boilerplate 'If additional space is needed...' line, no table. Cover: 'Steve Farrell', County Council Seat A, District written 'County large', party 'GOP'; Partisan Convention box only, convention date April 7, 2026.
